description: This file is a shell script (.sh) used for analyzing and processing Valgrind error logs from test runs, organizing errors, and managing error output files.

methods.name: start_output
methods.description: Initializes the output for a new Valgrind error, creates message files, and updates error count.

methods.name: finish_output
methods.description: Finalizes the current error output, manages copying of message files for errors grouped together.

methods.name: output_all
methods.description: Organizes Valgrind errors by backtrace, sorts, and outputs duplicate errors collectively.

methods.name: handle_one
methods.description: Processes a single Valgrind output file, extracting backtrace errors and messages.
